preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree must not be None.
The value of the root node must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of nodes in the binary tree must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned list must equal the number of nodes in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**5 for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list must be between 1 and 100,000.
The returned list must match the inorder traversal of the tree.
